entities.summary: Mateusz Ponitka is a Polish professional basketball player for Bahçeşehir Koleji of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL). He also represents the senior Poland national team in international competitions. Standing at a height of 6 ft 6 in (1.98 m), he plays at the small forward position.
